title: Arrest by National High-Tech Crime Unit
summary: Gary McKinnon tells of Arrest by National High-Tech Crime Unit, about 2002 at London, UK, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I'm Jeff Donsson from the National High-Tech Crime Unit. You're under arrest for computer misuse.

plain: Gary McKinnon, a British computer hacker who says he found signs of a secret space program while breaking into NASA computers, says he was arrested in London around 2002. He recalls an officer named Jeff Donsson, from a British police unit for computer crime called the National High-Tech Crime Unit, telling him he was under arrest for computer misuse. It is the moment his hacking, which he links to hidden space secrets, caught up with him.
